tags.label: DOCS
tags.meaning: Stated in a vendor's published documentation or release note. The source names the page and its revision date.

tags.label: MEASURED
tags.meaning: Run or read by us on a real system on the date given. Our own note, not a vendor statement: a later release may differ.

tags.label: DECK
tags.meaning: A claim in a Ping presentation. Not checked on our tenant.

tags.label: LAB READING
tags.meaning: Our reading of a schema, a sibling lab or a vendor sample. A reasonable inference, not a statement and not a measurement.

tags.label: UNVERIFIED
tags.meaning: No source found. Check before quoting.

statuses.meaning: The docs state, or we measured, that a token from this kind of issuer is accepted. The note says exactly what was shown.
The product has a place to trust this kind of issuer. A real token from it has not been shown to be accepted.
We tried and did not get a token accepted, and cannot say why.
Does not apply here. The note says why.
No source. Check before relying on it.

messageSources.meaning: The wording is quoted from the vendor documentation.
The wording is what the product returned when we ran the same case. Copied, not generated.
The wording was written by this lab. The product's own text for this case is not known.
